Description:

An Able Seaman position is available for deck crew on oil industry vessels operating in the United Arab Emirates. Candidates require STCW White List II/5 certification and a minimum of one year’s onboard experience on similar vessels within the UAE. Proficiency in English and basic computer skills are also necessary.
